summary: Formal backend verification of (1) Widen Reconciler coverage and (2) Bulk Transfer Parity billing on the Nomadly Node.js backend proxied through FastAPI. All 5 pytest cases PASSED against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: health, /api/dev/reconciler-widen-test, /api/dev/bulk-transfer-billing-test, and both regressions (/api/dev/call-reconciler-test, /api/dev/twilio-ivr-transfer-billing-test).
critical_code_review_comments: Widen Reconciler dev endpoint returns exactly the required shape (pass=true, all 7 checks true, summary scanned=3/reconciled=2/leaksFound=1/needsReview=1/settled=0/dryRun=true) confirming static wiring guards at all three widened sites (twilio_sip_bridge, twilio_sip_outbound, telnyx_bridge) and DETECTION-ONLY policy for Telnyx legs (never auto-settled).

Bulk Transfer Parity endpoint returns pass=true with expectedCharge=0.3 and observedCharge=0.3 -- flat IVR rate applied (2 min x $0.15), NOT intl forwarding rate ($1.00). Idempotency & no-answer-not-billed both verified.
Regressions (call reconciler + single Quick IVR transfer billing) remain green -- no regression from the widening.
seed_data_creation: None from tester side; the two dev endpoints seed and self-clean their own fixtures on dev sandbox sharing production DB (dry-run + rollback, no production wallet touched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_reconciler_widen_and_bulk_transfer.py; export env vars from /app/frontend/.env before running pytest so REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is resolvable (otherwise MissingSchema). All 5 tests pass in ~3.4s.
